title: Your files. Close at hand.
subtitle: Join the sender’s Wi-Fi or local network. No receiver app needed.
networkHelp: Stay connected when Wi-Fi reports “no internet”. Scan the sender’s web QR code or paste the entry credential.
pending: Waiting for sender approval. This request expires in about two minutes.
notCompared: Tests only this connection; does not switch networks.
downloadHelp: When ready, tap Start download. Check the browser download manager for the saved file.
privacy: Read-only sharing: receivers cannot upload, delete or modify source files. HTTP is unencrypted; use a trusted local network.
sentHelp: Progress and average speed refer to this response; Range may send only a portion. Sent does not mean saved or verified. Check browser downloads.
unstable: Content version unverified; do not change the source
probeUnsupported: Streaming probes are unavailable in this browser. You can still download files.
generic: Unable to complete this action. Check your connection and retry.
authorization_required: Authorization expired or was revoked. Please pair again.
invalid_entry: Invalid entry credential. Scan the sender’s QR code again.
not_found: The share or task is no longer available. Refresh and pair again.
sharing_paused: The sender has paused new tasks. Please try later.
queue_full: The queue is full. Please try later.
probe_busy: A download or probe is active. Try again when idle.
source_or_server_unavailable: The source is unreadable or sharing has ended. Contact the sender.
source_changed: The source changed. The sender needs to select and share it again.
pairing_rate_limit: Too many pairing attempts. Please try later.
receiver_limit: The receiver limit has been reached. Contact the sender.
download_not_ready: No download slot is available. Please queue again.
networkError: Connection interrupted. Rejoin the sender’s network and retry.
recommendedHelp: Native browser download is recommended for large files. Advanced streaming is optional and is not necessarily faster.
websocketHelp: Requires supported secure-context streaming file access. Uses the same download limits; speed depends on your environment.
websocketFallback: This browser cannot stream-save WebSocket files here. Browser download is available.
estimateHelp: Estimates only this connection, excluding queue, storage and preparation time. Concurrent downloads affect estimates. Other networks have not been compared.
adviceStreaming: WebSocket selected; streaming save is available. Native download is in file details. Their speeds have not been compared.
restoredTask: Task status restored. Downloads will not restart automatically.
downloadReady: Ready. Tap Start download to save the file.
downloadQueued: Queued. Tap Start download when it becomes available.
checkDownloads: Download requested. Confirm any browser prompt. Open Where is my download? to find the file. If nothing happens, open the share link in a standalone browser such as Safari and pair again.
restoredComplete: Sent record restored. Confirm the saved file in the browser download manager.
browserHelp: If an in-app browser cannot download, open the share link in a standalone browser such as Safari, then scan the QR code again or enter the pairing token. Stay on the sender hotspot or the same local network.
saveLocationIntro: Your browser saves the file, usually in Downloads. The actual location follows your browser settings or your choice when downloading.
saveLocationApple: Safari: tap the download arrow beside the address bar. Or open Files → Browse → iCloud Drive or On My iPhone / iPad → Downloads. Check Safari → Downloads in system settings for the configured location.
saveLocationAndroid: Open your browser menu → Downloads, or the system Files app → Downloads / Download. You can also tap the completed download notification.
saveLocationDesktop: Open the browser download list and choose Show in folder or Show in Finder. Chrome / Edge / Firefox on Windows or Linux usually use Ctrl+J; on macOS, open Downloads from the browser menu.
saveLocationChoice: To choose a folder, enable Ask where to save each file in browser settings. Supported browsers also offer Choose location and save in file details. This page cannot open your system Downloads folder or read the actual path of a native download.
savedToChosenLocation: Saved to the location you selected. Open the file there.
adviceMeasured: Observed speed recommendation on this connection:
downloadFailure: This task failed or its permit expired. Check the network, then prepare a new download. A new task does not guarantee resume.
downloadRequested: Download requested. Check your browser downloads.
sentShort: Sent. Check your browser to confirm saving.
